name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Deluxe Edition
storyline: The story follows the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi as he journeys through a dark fantasy vision of Kyoto during Japan's Edo period. In this shadowy, supernatural version of the ancient capital, Musashi crosses blades with rival swordsmen while confronting far more terrifying foes: demons and other monstrous threats that lurk beyond the world of the living. Armed with his sword and honed reflexes, he strikes, parries, and turns his enemies' own momentum against them as he cuts a path through the perils that await. Set against the atmospheric backdrop of a haunted feudal Japan, the tale follows one master warrior's deadly struggle against the encroaching darkness.
summary:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Onimusha: Way of the Sword

• Deluxe Kit - A set containing a variety of items that can be used to change Miyamoto Musashi's appearance, and charms that he can equip:
• Charm: Oni Lady
• Charm: Little Dancer
• Charm: Mentor
• Sword Appearance: Bamboo & Panda
• Sword Appearance: Whittled Oar
• Sword Appearance: Raizan
• Sword Appearance: Enryuu
• Outfit for Musashi: Red Armor
• Oni Gauntlet: Crimson Lotus
